tbesh_html:
1) to behave proudly, act stormily or boisterously or arrogantly
1a) (Qal) to act insolently, storm against, beset, importune
1b) (Hiphil) to disturb, alarm, awe, confuse, make bold or proud

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently
strongs_1890.kjv_def: overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen.
